meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文榜单，提炼市场热点与热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是网文作者或编辑,想了解平台榜单背后的热门题材趋势。
copy.tagline_en: Scan web novel rankings to identify hot genres and trends.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a web novel author or editor wanting to understand market trends from ranking data.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会当长篇网文市场分析师：用脚本采集起点、番茄、晋江等平台的榜单数据，清洗后输出扫榜报告，并给出 2-3 个带可行性、失败风险的选题建议，写入输出目录的「选题决策.md」。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜 等命令，或问「长篇什么火」这类问题时触发；它会先问你目标平台和题材方向，再开始采集。

say.text: 帮我扫一遍起点月票榜和新书榜
say.note: 先确认平台和方向，再采集并出报告

say.text: 看看番茄男频最近什么题材火
say.note: 采集番茄榜单后给题材热度排行

say.text: 把扫榜结果整理成选题决策
say.note: 产出 2-3 个选题，含可行性评估

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a long-form web-novel market analyst: it collects ranking data from Qidian, Fanqie, Jinjiang etc. via scripts, cleans it, then writes a scan report and 2-3 topic picks with feasibility and failure risks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run /story-long-scan, /长篇扫榜 or ask what's hot in long-form web novels; it first asks which platform and genre direction you want.

say_en.text: Scan Qidian's monthly-ticket and new-book rankings for me
say_en.note: Asks platform and direction first, then collects and reports

say_en.text: See which genres are hot in Fanqie's male-channel rankings
say_en.note: Collects Fanqie rankings, then ranks genre heat

say_en.text: Turn the scan results into topic decisions
